[RBND.5.1] **Dialect-binding check.** When two artifacts are
loaded together — a profile against a DSC, an event trace
against a DSC + engine, a trace against a DSC + engine — the
dialect tuple from the secondary artifact MUST equal the
dialect tuple from the primary artifact (the DSC).
Element-wise equality across all three fields. An event trace that carries no
tuple at all is the one exception, replayed without the check ([RBND.2.1]).
